name: Order Form from the CRM, by Deal Tier
summary: A CRM call routes an order form by deal tier: a Standard deal is generated and sent for signature, a Strategic deal is held for Deal Desk, and anything else goes back to the rep.
description: A rep closes an opportunity in the CRM, which starts this workflow by API with the customer, the signer, the quote number and the deal tier. A Standard deal gets Fontara's order form generated from the CRM's values and sent to the customer and Fontara's signatory; a Strategic deal is held for Deal Desk, who negotiate those on paper first; anything else is sent back to the rep. Pattern: an API start from a CRM opportunity, branching on a starting value with Add a Multi Branch Rule. Fontara's signatory on a Standard deal is fixed to the VP of Sales (signing authority up to $1,000,000 on Fontara, Inc. paper, per the escalation matrix).
